observation.visible_scene: Interior room corner seen from below a pale ceiling. A lit three-arm chandelier with frosted white glass shades hangs from a metal ceiling canopy via a short chain. The walls are covered in mauve wallpaper with a white leaf/line pattern; a small framed portrait/icon is mounted on the wall, the top edge of a wooden door is visible at lower left, and a dark wooden cabinet stands at right. As the view shifts, a framed photo collage on the left wall enters the frame.
visible_changes: The camera slowly pans and tilts: background features (the framed portrait, the door top, the cabinet, and the ceiling line) drift steadily toward the right and downward across the frame, and new left-wall content (a photo collage) comes into view.

The chandelier's shades change position and orientation relative to the fixed ceiling canopy over the clip, consistent with a gentle sway of the fixture; its apparent tilt and the spread of the side arms shift from frame to frame.
The three bulbs remain illuminated throughout the excerpt; no object enters or leaves the lit fixture.
No person or other moving object appears in the scene.
outside_clip_unknowns: What initiated the chandelier's sway before the crop, and whether it continues, damps out, or reverses after the last frame.
The full room layout and lighting conditions beyond the area swept by the camera pan.
uncertain_details: The exact camera motion type (rotation/pan vs sideways translation) is not fully determined; the background drift confirms camera movement but not its precise form.

It is partly uncertain how much of the chandelier's apparent shift is true swinging versus depth/parallax effects from the camera motion; the relative change between the shades and the ceiling canopy indicates some genuine fixture movement.
The period and direction of the chandelier's oscillation cannot be established from this single short segment.
